BiblicalUsage: Artaxerxes' letter tells Ezra to buy bullocks, rams and lambs with the king's silver, for offerings on the altar in Jerusalem. One verse, one purchase — a pagan king's money buying God's sacrifices.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God can turn a king's treasury toward his altar, and no money is too far gone for him to use.
